name: Synthia-MRSA-Alpha1
molecularRationale: Engineered with an amphipathic alpha-helical partition: alternating cationic Lysine (K) residues align along the electrostatic face to displace divalent cations on teichoic acids, while hydrophobic Leucine (L), Tryptophan (W), and Valine (V) residues embed deeply into the hydrophobic lipid bilayer core to trigger toroidal pore formation.
membraneAffinityExplanation: The calculated net charge of +5.1 provides rapid attraction to the negative -32 mV surface potential of MRSA, while a moderate hydrophobic moment (0.48) ensures minimal hemolytic damage to mammalian erythrocytes.
